items.text: report a bug. On a computer, the bug in the lower left; on any device, Settings › report a bug. Say what happened; Current adds what it knows about the moment (version, browser, what was playing, recent errors), shown before you send
if the sound ever has to restart itself, Current offers to report it
on a computer the index's pin sits at the right end of the index's icon row, over the move handles; the top bar is for the duck and the namemark only
when the sound panel's tabs run out of room, they show icons only, the open one lit, and its name moves to the top of the panel (no more TOU)

touchable sound can no longer silence the music. Sweep moves its filter more gently, and if a browser's filter ever breaks (Safari on iPhone could, dragging with Sweep on), it is replaced on the spot and the sound comes back
one pin everywhere, the push pin: the sections' keep pins, the popovers' pins and the index's pin all mean the same thing, stays open
on a computer the index's pin sits at the top, beside close
the sound shelf's react button just says react; its colour shows on or off (screen readers still hear which)
on a phone, the sound shelf's labels no longer run into each other: two touch sounds read like "sweep +1", a look's own links read "links", and any label too long for its button ends in an ellipsis
Founders Club says how to unlock the pack on another device: join again there with the same email
